description: Answers: can I fly my drone now, when today or this week, where (compare up to 5 places), which day is best, and why not. Judges every hour against the user's own thresholds, flying hours and profile, and returns good windows, the runs of hours that fail and why, per-day summaries for longer ranges, and weather warnings in effect. "Good" means within the user's own UAV Forecast limits, not safe; airspace, permissions, aircraft limits and battery are not included. Current factor keys: wind_at_altitude, max_altitude, temp_or_wind_chill, humidity, delta_t, precip_prob, precip_intensity, thunder_prob, cloud_cover, cloud_base, icing, visibility, sun_elevation, gps, kp, gps_kp, gust_at_altitude; unknown keys may appear. Current notice kinds: weather_alert; more kinds may appear. Anything the plan, region or data sources don't include is listed under "unavailable" with a reason (plan, region, source, setting).

days.description: From now to local midnight after this many days (1 = the rest of today). Not with start/end or hours.

end.description: Local date or date-time; exclusive for a date-time, inclusive for a date.

hours.description: From now for this many hours. Not with start/end or days.

places.description: Favorite location names, place names, coordinates, or "here".

items.description: A favorite location's name, a place name, "lat, lon" coordinates, or "here".

profile.description: A saved settings profile's name, to answer with that profile's settings instead of the current ones.

start.description: Local date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM) at the place.

name: check_good_to_fly

altitude.description: Height above ground the value applies at.

factor.description: Factor key. Current keys: wind_at_altitude, max_altitude, temp_or_wind_chill, humidity, delta_t, precip_prob, precip_intensity, thunder_prob, cloud_cover, cloud_base, icing, visibility, sun_elevation, gps, kp, gps_kp, gust_at_altitude. Unknown keys may appear.

speed.description: Wind factors: gust or wind, the speed the value is. A wind factor judged by its gusts is reported as its gust factor.

status.description: good, too_low, too_high or in_excluded_band; not_counted when one of the user's app settings keeps the factor out of the verdict; others may appear.

respect_sun_elevation.description: Not before the sun is as high as the user's minimum sun elevation threshold, when one is enabled.

LocalTime.description: Local time at the place, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-11-18T07:15:00+13:00.

kind.description: Current kinds: weather_alert. Others may appear.

reason.description: plan, region, source, setting; others may appear.

Units.description: Display unit per quantity, e.g. {"wind": "km/h", "alt": "m"}. Altitudes are above ground (AGL).

status.description: ok or subscription_required; others may appear.

title: Check good to fly
